title: fix(components): place action:bar members authored action:menu / action:group (objectui#10345)
body:
Fixes #10345
Clause-②: no

On an `action:bar`, a single action's `component` now decides **where** it renders (ruling A, comment 5825579152). Before this change, a member authored `component: 'action:menu'` or `'action:group'` was handed alone to a renderer that reads `schema.actions`. That renderer returned null, so the action vanished and a `?runAction=` deep link to it ran nothing.

## What changed (all in `action-bar.tsx`)

- **`action:menu`**: the action goes into the bar's existing single overflow menu (the one "More" button). It is taken out **before** the `maxVisible` split, so it never spends an inline slot. `page:header` already reads the key this way ("forces an action into the `⋯` menu regardless of the count").
- **`action:group`**: the action renders inline, through the `action:button` renderer, inside a `ButtonGroup` (the existing `custom/button-group` primitive, `role="group"`). The group is shared with its adjacent `action:group` members.
- The docblock's opening paragraph now describes this placement. The usage-example line with the `trash-2` icon is untouched (draft PR objectui#8941 edits that line).
- No contract change. `action-menu.tsx` and `action-group.tsx` are untouched, and neither renderer is taught to accept a single action.

## "Adjacent", as measured and pinned

Adjacent means consecutive in the **inline row the bar draws**: after ordering (`order`, then primary), after the `maxVisible` cut, and with the menu-placed actions already removed.
- `[G1, G2, Plain, G3]` gives two groups, `[G1 G2]` and `[G3]`.
- `[G1, MenuPlaced, G2]` gives one group, `[G1 G2]`. The menu-placed action is not in the row, so it does not split the run.
- Each group member counts toward `maxVisible`. A member past the budget spills into the "More" menu like any inline member.

## PM mechanism assumptions, measured

- **A1 held.** A member routed into `combinedOverflow` runs its deep link through `action:menu`'s existing `ActionAutoTrigger` / `useAutoTriggerOnce`, with no new trigger code. Pinned by the probe's menu row and the deep-link rows.
- **A2: the assumption's risk was real, and it was avoided inside the file surface.** `action-group.tsx` draws its own `InlineActionButton`. It consumes no `autoTrigger`, and its `visible` gate is fail-soft where `action:button`'s is fail-closed. Routing grouped members through the `action:group` renderer would therefore leave the deep link dead, and would gate them differently from an inline member. So the bar draws the group itself and renders each member through `action:button`, the renderer an ungrouped member gets. The deep link runs and the gates are identical by construction. `action-group.tsx` needed no change, so there was no needs-decision fork.
- **A3.** A menu-placed member does **not** count toward `maxVisible` (pinned with `[M1, B1, B2]`, `maxVisible: 2`: both B's stay inline). An overflow that holds only menu-placed members renders exactly one "More" (pinned by the child count and the `aria-haspopup` count).
- **A4.** Overflow order: the actions that spilled past `maxVisible` come first, then the menu-placed ones, each in the bar's own order, then the separator and the system actions. This is the same relative order `page:header` uses. The pin includes a menu-placed member with `order: -1`, which sorts first in the bar but still does not claim the primary inline slot.
- **A5.** `requiredPermissions` is filtered before the split, so it gates every placement identically. Pins:
  - a hidden menu-placed member stays hidden in the opened menu, and its deep link is refused with the objectui#4191 notice instead of being run;
  - a hidden grouped member is not drawn while its group sibling is;
  - a disabled menu-placed member is a disabled menu item;
  - a capability the caller lacks hides the member at both placements. Each of those rows has a held-capability control leg, because the defect also reads "absent".

## The card's four-row probe, after the fix

| member `component` | executions | placement |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `action:button` | 1 | inline |
| `action:icon` | 1 | inline |
| `action:menu` | 1 | the "More" menu |
| `action:group` | 1 | a button group |

## Verification (at `da122c4cf`)

- New suite `action-bar-member-placement-10345.test.tsx`: 21/21 green.
- **Reverse proof.** `action-bar.tsx` was replaced with its blob at the base commit `0348bc9f1`, which removes the placement branch. The on-disk mutation was confirmed with grep counts: `inlineRow` went from 2 to 0, `inlineActions.map` from 0 to 1, and the file hash equalled the base blob. The suite then read **19 failed, 2 passed**. The 2 are the `action:button` / `action:icon` probe rows, which are correct in both worlds. The menu and group probe rows read 0 runs, matching the card's table. The file was restored with `git checkout HEAD`, and the restore was proved by the hash equalling the HEAD blob and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The first ablation run showed the capability rows staying green (they were vacuous), so the held control legs were added and the proof was re-run.
- 38 suites green, 668 tests (`pnpm exec vitest run` from the repo root). They were: every `@object-ui/components` suite naming `action-bar`, `action:bar`, `action:menu`, `action:group` or `useAutoTriggerOnce`; every file under `renderers/action/__tests__/`; the app-shell deep-link consumers (`EnvironmentListToolbar` deep-link suites and `useOfferedNavRunAction`); and the two script pins that name `action:bar`.
- The `@object-ui/components` dependency closure was built, then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components type-check` exited 0. That runs the package's own `tsc --noEmit` and `tsconfig.test.json`, and `--listFiles` shows both include the touched and new files.
- ESLint on the two touched source files: 0 errors. `action-bar.tsx` has 5 warnings at the base commit and 5 now, all on untouched lines.
- `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check:changeset-claims` ("No pending changeset names a file this change touches"), `check-vi-mock-override-shape`, `check-test-path-roots` and `check-lint-coverage` all exited 0.
- NOT MEASURED: the button group's rendered look in a real browser. jsdom computes no Tailwind, so the attached-button styling and `empty:hidden` were not observed.

## Changesets

- New: `.changeset/10345-action-bar-menu-group-placement.md` (`@object-ui/components`, patch).
- **Corrected in this PR:** the pending objectui#10274 entry said "`action:bar` renders each inline action with the renderer its `component` names". An inline `action:group` member now renders through `action:button`, so that sentence is narrowed to `action:button` / `action:icon`. Only the body changed; the front matter is byte-identical.
- Read and left alone as still true: the objectui#6306, objectui#7415, objectui#4191 and objectui#5493 entries. Their "renames the type as it spreads a member" and "decided by `maxVisible`" sentences describe members whose `component` does not place them, and the literal `type: componentType, actionType: action.type` spread is kept.

## Acceptance notes (observations, not filed)

- `action:group`'s own leaves (`InlineActionButton`, `DropdownActionItem`) consume no `autoTrigger`, while `auto-trigger.ts` states that every renderer that can receive an action consumes it. No host sends a flagged action into a standalone `action:group` today (the deep-link host composes an `action:bar`), so this is dormant and was not filed.
- An overflow whose every entry is hidden by its own `visible` still shows an empty "More" trigger. That was already true for spilled actions before this change.
- `content/docs/guide/slotted-pages.md` says `page:header` uses "the same rules as `action:bar`", including `component: 'action:menu'` pinning an action into the `⋯` menu. That sentence was false for `action:bar` before this change and is true after it.
